entities.label: Head and hand pose
entities.detail: High-rate transient motion where the local device owns immediate presentation.
entities.invariant: Local motion remains responsive; remote views receive bounded, disposable samples.

entities.label: Exclusively held tool
entities.detail: One participant manipulates a shared object while everyone must agree on the owner.
entities.invariant: At most one valid owner controls the tool at a time.

entities.label: Approved configuration
entities.detail: A consequential shared change that must be ordered, validated, and recoverable after reconnect.
entities.invariant: Every participant converges on one validated durable version.

authorityModes.label: Local state, sampled remotely
authorityModes.detail: Render locally and send disposable snapshots for interpolation on other devices.

authorityModes.label: Owner authority with lease
authorityModes.detail: A session grants one bounded owner; the owner updates while peers reject stale lease epochs.

authorityModes.label: Session-authoritative commit
authorityModes.detail: A trusted service validates and orders accepted changes; clients may anticipate visuals.
